title: What is Scopex?
content: Scopex is a zero-fee money transfer platform for NRIs sending money from Europe and the US to India. It offers better exchange rates than traditional banks, with no hidden charges. Scopex was founded in 2022 and has transferred over EUR 180M for more than 70,000 NRIs. Money transfers in the EEA, UK and US are handled through regulated, licensed partners, and Scopex does not hold customer funds. Customer support is available 24/7 through live chat in the app and on the website, and through the contact page at https://scopex.com/contact-us/.

title: How to create a Scopex account
content: To create an account: 1) Download the Scopex app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store. 2) Tap Sign Up and choose Continue with Google, Continue with Apple, or Sign up with Email (email sign-up sends a verification code to your inbox). 3) Enter a referral code if you have one. If you used a friend's referral link, the code is applied automatically. 4) Tap the 'Verify Now' banner to start account verification.
questions: Can I sign up with Google or Apple?

title: How to complete account verification
content: Verification steps: 1) On the Home screen, tap the 'Verify Now' banner. 2) Phone verification: enter your mobile number and the SMS OTP. 3) Address verification: EU users enter their current European address, US users enter their current US address. 4) KYC: choose your country of residence and a supported document, upload it and take a selfie. 5) Wallet creation: after KYC is approved, tap 'Create Wallet' and set up a passkey on your device. 6) Wallet activation: tap 'Activate Wallet' and confirm with the same passkey. After the wallet is set up, new EU users receive EUR 10 and new US users receive USD 20 in their wallet.

title: How long KYC verification takes
content: When details are clear and correct, KYC is usually verified in 2-3 minutes. Some cases need extra manual or compliance checks and can take up to an hour. If KYC is approved, you can continue to wallet creation. If KYC is rejected, the app shows the reason and lets you re-upload documents; follow the KYC submission guidelines. If KYC is still under review after more than 1 hour, contact the support team.
questions: How much time does verification take?

title: KYC submission do's and don'ts
content: Do: take a clear photo of the document and a selfie in good light; keep all four edges of the document visible; make sure your full face is visible in the selfie; use an ID that is valid for at least the next 3 months. Don't: upload blurry, cropped or dark images; submit expired documents; cover your face with glasses, hands or shadows; upload soft copies or digital IDs. Only original physical documents are accepted.

title: Documents supported for KYC
content: KYC is required by law for regulated remittance providers to verify identity, prevent fraud and money laundering, and keep transactions secure. Transfers cannot be processed without KYC. Documents are encrypted and only used for verification. Supported documents: in the Euro zone, an EU passport, Indian passport, residence permit or driving licence; in the United States, only US government-issued documents.
questions: Can I use my driving licence?

title: Supported currencies
content: Scopex currently supports two corridors to India: Eurozone to India (EUR to INR) and United States to India (USD to INR). More currencies are planned and will be announced in the help center.

title: What a passkey is and how Scopex uses it
content: A passkey is a password-free way to sign in: you unlock your device with fingerprint, face scan or PIN, and cryptographic keys verify your identity. Passkeys protect against weak passwords, phishing and reused credentials. Scopex creates a unique passkey on your device when you create your wallet. You authenticate with this passkey to activate your wallet and to approve every transfer, so only your device can authorise transactions.
questions: Why do I need a passkey?

title: Why Scopex rates may differ from Google
content: Google does not offer an API for real-time exchange rates, so Scopex uses Yahoo Finance as its market rate source. Scopex fetches the rate every 5 minutes, so small differences from Yahoo Finance can appear in between updates. Scopex mentions Google in its ads because most people check rates on Google. On NRO and savings accounts Scopex advertises a rate 25 paise better than the Google rate. Live rates are always shown in the app before you confirm a transfer.

title: How secure are my data and transactions?
content: Scopex security features: passkey authentication tied to your device with biometric verification; end-to-end encryption of transactions and data in transit and at rest; no transfer is processed without your explicit approval with your passkey; resetting your passkey requires verifying your identity through your registered email. Scopex uses bank-grade encryption and works with regulated, licensed partners in the EEA, UK and US.

title: Unable to create wallet
content: Wallet creation needs a passkey. If you see 'Passkeys are not supported on this device', your device is too old to support passkeys; use a compatible device. If you see 'Use a different device or USB security key', passkeys are not enabled. On iPhone: Settings > General > Autofill Passwords and Passkeys, and select the Passwords app as the autofill provider. On Android: Settings > search 'Autofill service' > make sure Google is selected > tap 'Autofill with Google' and check the right Gmail account is listed. Then try creating the wallet again. If it still fails, talk to a support specialist.
questions: Use a different device or USB security key error

title: Passkey issues when activating wallet or approving a transfer
content: 'No passkey found' means your Scopex passkey is not on this device (deleted, device reset, or a different device). Fix: recover your wallet - open the app, tap the Profile icon (top-left of Home), choose Wallet Recovery, tap Recover then Verify, enter the OTP sent to your registered email, and create and save a new passkey in your passkey manager. Then retry activating the wallet or approving the transfer. 'Use a different device or USB security key' means passkeys are not enabled: enable them (iPhone: Settings > General > Autofill Passwords and Passkeys, Passwords app selected; Android: Autofill service set to Google), then recover your wallet and retry. Microsoft Authenticator is not supported for passkeys. On Samsung devices, save the passkey in Google Password Manager instead of Samsung Pass.

title: Unable to add a recipient
content: If you cannot add a recipient: check that the recipient's bank account is active, and check that the IFSC code is correct. If the branch recently moved or merged, its IFSC code may have changed, so confirm the latest code with the recipient or their bank. If it still fails, contact customer support.

title: How to add a recipient
content: To add a recipient: open the sidebar menu from the home screen and select Recipients, tap Add New Recipient, pick an avatar and nickname, enter the recipient's IFSC code and account number, then tap Continue and Add Recipient.

title: Instant vs standard SEPA transfers
content: When you pay from an EU bank, your bank may offer two SEPA types. Instant SEPA: funds usually reach Scopex within a few minutes and it works 24/7 including weekends and holidays. Standard SEPA: funds usually arrive in 1-3 business days and are processed only during banking hours (Monday-Friday, excluding holidays). If your bank does not let you choose, it decides automatically.
questions: Why is my bank transfer slow?

title: Minimum and maximum transfer limits
content: Minimum transfer: EUR 50 or USD 50. There is no daily limit, but the maximum per transaction is INR 4,99,999; larger amounts must be split into multiple transfers of up to INR 4,99,999 each. US accounts have ramp-up limits in the first 60 days: up to USD 1,000 per week, up to USD 2,000 total in the first 30 days, up to USD 5,000 total in the first 60 days, and limits are lifted after 60 days. For transfers above EUR 10,000, Scopex may ask for a Source of Funds (SOF) document as part of compliance checks.

title: How to make a bank transfer
content: To send money and pay by bank transfer: 1) Tap Send Money on the home page and enter the amount. 2) If you have a promo code, tap Unlock bonus and Add. 3) Choose Bank transfer under 'Paying With' and tap Send. 4) Select the recipient and the purpose of transfer. 5) Review the details, create the transaction and tap PAY NOW. 6) Select your bank and follow the on-screen steps to pay.

title: How to make a wallet transfer
content: To send money using your wallet balance: 1) Tap Send Money and enter the amount. 2) Apply a promo code with Unlock bonus if you have one. 3) Choose Wallet transfer under 'Paying With' and tap Send. 4) Select the recipient and purpose of transfer. 5) Check the details and tap 'Confirm & Send with wallet'. 6) Approve with your passkey. The transfer then completes within the standard processing time.

title: Are there hidden or transaction fees?
content: Scopex transfers are free: there is no transaction fee and no hidden cost. The amount you see is the exact amount processed. The only fee mentioned in the help center is for extra refunds: one refund every three months is free, and additional refunds in the same period cost 1% of that transfer amount.

title: Manual transfer FAQ
content: Use a manual transfer if your bank is not listed or open banking payment fails. Scopex shows you the payment details and you pay from your own bank app. Enter the exact recipient name shown on the Manual Transfer page. If your bank flags the recipient name as wrong, you can still proceed as long as the IBAN and amount are correct. If the BIC in your bank app looks different, you can ignore it; the IBAN decides where the money goes. Include the reference number if one is shown; if not, skip it. Seeing your own name as the recipient is expected, because Scopex creates a virtual IBAN in your name to link your payment to your transfer.

title: Transfers to NRE accounts
content: Scopex supports transfers to NRE, NRO and savings accounts. All are fee-free. NRE transfers get a slightly different rate: the extra 25 paise benefit applies to NRO and savings accounts but not NRE, because NRE processing costs more. The app shows a rate preview comparing NRE and NRO before you confirm, and you can use 'Change recipient' there to change the account. NRE credits arrive directly from a recognised Indian bank (ICICI, HDFC or Federal Bank), so they are compatible with NRE accounts. Transfers are international remittances, not MTSS. A FIRC (remittance proof) can only be issued by your own bank, so request it from them.

title: What each transaction status means
content: Send Funds From Your Bank: the rate is booked and the transaction started, but your bank payment is still pending. Verifying Your Deposited Funds: you paid and Scopex is waiting to receive the funds from your bank. Approve Transfer: funds were received and verified, and Scopex is waiting for your approval. Transfer in Process: you approved and Scopex is sending the money to the recipient. Transfer Completed: the money has been successfully remitted to the recipient.
questions: What does my transfer status mean?

title: How long a transfer takes after approval
content: About 80% of transfers clear within 30 minutes of approval, and almost all complete within 24 hours of approval. Delays can happen during busy periods or when a transaction needs extra security checks. If the money has not arrived within 24 hours after Scopex received your funds, contact support.

title: Payment made but transaction not visible
content: EU bank payments can take time to reach Scopex depending on the transfer type. A transaction auto-expires 48 hours after you pay if Scopex has not received the funds. When the payment does arrive, it is automatically credited to your Scopex wallet, and you can use that wallet balance to create a new transaction at any time.
questions: Money went to my wallet instead

title: Payment made but transaction still not verified
content: 'Verifying your deposited funds' means Scopex is still waiting for your bank's payment. EU: instant payments usually arrive within 30 minutes; standard transfers can take 1-3 bank working days. US (ACH): payments are processed in batches during business hours, and batch times vary by bank. Missing a cutoff moves you to the next batch; transfers started after hours, on weekends or holidays wait for the next business day. You get an in-app notification to approve the transfer once funds arrive.

title: The rate went up - can I get the higher rate?
content: Scopex locks your exchange rate when you start a transfer and keeps it valid for 1 hour. You must pay within that hour, and the money must arrive within 48 hours to keep the locked rate. After payment the rate is final and cannot be changed, even if the market rate rises. This protects both sides from market swings. Tip: keep your wallet funded so you can lock a good rate immediately.

How long is the rate valid?

title: Transfer completed but recipient has not received the money
content: Scopex marks a transfer Completed only after receiving the UTR (Unique Transaction Reference) from the bank. Sometimes the recipient's bank takes longer to credit the money, and rarely a reversal happens during bank reconciliation. What to do: wait until 12 PM the next day. If the money still has not arrived, contact Scopex support through live chat or email, and share the recipient's bank statement as a PDF covering one day before the transfer up to today.

title: Referral program
content: Find your referral link under Profile > Refer & Earn and share it. Your friend must sign up with your link or code and complete a transfer of EUR 50 / USD 50 or more. When 3 referred friends complete qualifying transfers, you earn EUR 50 (EU) or USD 50 (US), credited to your wallet. Send the reward to a recipient with a wallet transfer. Referral rewards are non-refundable. If your friend did not use your link or code at sign-up, the referral cannot be counted. Limited-time referral campaigns may run on top of this; check the What's New section of the help center for current offers.

title: How to cancel a transfer and request a refund
content: Refunds can only be requested before a transfer is approved; approved transfers cannot be refunded. You get one free refund every three months, covering one transaction only. Each extra refund in the same three-month period costs 1% of that transfer amount. Transfers above INR 4,99,999 are split into multiple transactions, and each counts separately for refunds. To request a refund, contact support with your Transfer ID and the reason for the refund.
